title: Establish scoped studio/.dockerignore and enable Next.js standalone tracing

violation.problem: studio/.dockerignore is missing, allowing host node_modules and local artifacts to bleed into container builds when initiated from studio/. Furthermore, studio/next.config.ts lacks output: 'standalone', forcing Dockerfile to copy full node_modules into the runtime container.
violation.expectedSolution: Add studio/.dockerignore excluding node_modules, .next, and secrets, and configure output: 'standalone' in studio/next.config.ts.

steps: Create studio/.dockerignore containing node_modules, .next, .env*, and build caches.
In studio/next.config.ts, add output: 'standalone' to the nextConfig object.
reviewChecklist: Production builds remain hermetic and isolated from local build artifacts
